LanguageData.RHAH_Royal_Arrival: A ratkin claiming to be a member of the Ratkin Kingdom’s royal family has arrived near our colony. It seems he has something to say.
LanguageData.RHAH_Royal_Request: “Hello. I am an impoverished royal from the great Ratkin Kingdom. Give me 2500 silver, and once I have secured a title from the emperor in a year’s time, I will repay you tenfold.”
LanguageData.RHAH_Royal_Fraud: Looks like we were swindled. That damned fellow claiming to be royalty walked away with all that silver!
LanguageData.RHAH_Royal_Thanks: Ha! My friend, thank you so much for your help. Now it is time to keep my promise.\n\n--A {0}
LanguageData.RHAH_Royal_Peace: Oh, my friend, I also smoothed things over for you at court. No need to thank me.
LanguageData.RHAH_Royal_Lost: A year has passed. The visitor who claimed to be royalty has never written back, and the promised silver has not arrived.
